camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamsPublishList --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy publish_time_desc --StreamType all --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --PageSize 1500 --DomainName 'example.com' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --QueryType fuzzy --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Retrieves the historical stream ingest records of a domain name, an application under a domain name, or a specific stream within a specified time range
description_zh: 获取某一时间段内某个域名（或域名下某应用或某个流）的历史推流记录
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-streams-publish-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --page-size 1500 --page-number 1 --stream-type all --query-type fuzzy --order-by publish_time_desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamsPublishList

parameters.help_en:
The ingest domain or streamer streaming domain.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user calling this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name
parameters.help_zh:
推流域名或主播流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. You can view StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of stream ingest. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过30天。 格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 3000. Default value: 2000
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1~3000，默认值为2000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

Not specified: queries raw streams.
all: queries all streams.
trans: queries transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
流类型。取值：

不传：查询原始流。
all：查询所有流。
trans：查询转码流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy match for the stream name. Valid values:
fuzzy (default): fuzzy match.
strict: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
指定是否模糊匹配流名称。取值：
fuzzy（默认值）：模糊匹配。
strict：精准匹配
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method. Valid values:

stream_name_desc: sorts by live stream name in descending order.
stream_name_asc: sorts by live stream name in ascending order.
publish_time_desc: sorts by stream ingest time in descending order.
publish_time_asc (default): sorts by stream ingest time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值：

stream_name_desc：按直播流名称倒序。
stream_name_asc：按直播流名称升序。
publish_time_desc：按推流时间倒序。
publish_time_asc（默认值）：按推流时间升序
parameters.name: order_by
